$comment: Moment pieces cut from the archived 78 rpm originals (tools/assets/approved.json, kind 'recording'). scripts/audio/prep-moment-music.py builds a denoised and a raw variant of each, measures them (tools/assets/moment-pieces.report.json) and writes the manifest entry. segment = [start, end] in seconds of the original side; noiseRegion = groove-only seconds for the hiss profile (default: the lead-in groove, or the quietest second with noise 'quietest'); variant forces the default variant (otherwise chosen from the metrics). target 'private' = US-risky: private-assets/ only. Owner approval: .docs/assets/candidates/moment-music.md#decision-2026-09-26.
